punchline: Skinner's pigeons tapped the lever far more once food came only after a random number of taps.
thirty_sec: B.F. Skinner put pigeons in a box where pressing a lever dropped food. Then he made it random: sometimes food, sometimes nothing. The pigeons tapped much more. Nir Eyal says your inbox works the same way three times over: who wrote, what opportunity might be in there, and the itch to clear the unread count.
